evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as categories of value, enacting proportionality between possession and cost — a market-pricing relational frame.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Splits substrate (commodity) from perspective (asset) along a cost-benefit axis, performing proportionality between what is disposable and what is retained.
